Agent Name: Engineer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Engineer made a logic error in the implementation of the `min_candies` function. Specifically, in the forward pass (left-to-right), the condition `if arr[i] >= arr[i - 1]` was used instead of `if arr[i] > arr[i - 1]`. According to the problem statement, students with a **higher** rating should get more candies than their neighbors, not students with equal or higher ratings. This means that if two adjacent students have the same rating, they should receive the same number of candies (or at least not have the left one receive fewer than the right one due to a higher rating). The use of `>=` incorrectly forces the right student to receive more candies even when their rating is equal to the left student's, which violates the "higher rating" requirement and can lead to suboptimal candy distribution. This is a classic boundary condition error where the strict inequality (`>`) was replaced with a non-strict one (`>=`), similar to the pattern seen in Example 2 (Case #119) where a stricter condition was incorrectly applied.
